title: core: update ValidationConfig::allowed_groups for wildmat patterns
description:
## What
Update ValidationConfig::allowed_groups in crates/core/src/validation.rs from exact-match Vec<GroupName> to GroupFilter-based pattern matching; update transit startup to build the filter from config.

## Algorithm
1. In crates/core/src/validation.rs, change: allowed_groups: Option<Vec<GroupName>> → allowed_groups: Option<Arc<GroupFilter>>
2. In validate_article_ingress(), change the allowed_groups check (currently uses set.contains()): replace with filter.accepts(group.as_str()) for each group in h.newsgroups; reject article if NONE of the Newsgroups values match the filter (all groups filtered = reject)
3. In crates/transit/src/main.rs startup: build GroupFilter from config.groups.names (same Arc as whss.5); set ValidationConfig { allowed_groups: Some(Arc::clone(&filter)), ... }
4. Update all tests in crates/core that construct ValidationConfig with allowed_groups = Some(vec![...]) to use GroupFilter::new() instead
5. Update crates/integration-tests if it constructs ValidationConfig with exact groups

## Defensive programming rules
- If allowed_groups is None: accept all groups (no filter active) — preserve existing behavior
- Rejection message must be actionable: "article rejected: none of its groups match the configured group filter"
- Do not log group names at info level during validation (high volume path)
- Arc<GroupFilter> to allow shared ownership between ValidationConfig and PipelineCtx

## Agent team
Standard: Agent R (read validation.rs + main.rs startup ValidationConfig construction), Agent I (update type + validation check + startup), Agent V (cargo test --workspace + clippy)

## Tests
Tests in whss.7 cover the full accept/reject flow. whss.6 needs cargo test --workspace clean.
